name: Ram thit nuong
summary: Ram thịt nướng, as Vietnam Airlines describes it, is marinated pork rolled in thin rice paper and grilled over charcoal. It names the plate for holidays and for guests.
taste: Vietnam Airlines calls the pork rich and the dip sour, hot, salty, and sweet together.
howToEat: Vietnam Airlines: marinate the pork, roll it in thin rice paper, and grill it over charcoal until it spots and smells fragrant. Eat it with fresh rice noodles, herbs, unripe banana, cucumber, and mắm nêm.
No street and no hour were printed. The hour is Check on arrival.
priceBand: Vietnam Airlines prints from 100,000 VND for a portion for three people.
seoTitle: Ram thit nuong — grilled pork rolls
